name: Never Shall We Part
source:
A lonely witch and a reckless girl fall in love, but recklessness has a cost and lonely girls don't let go easily.

[From [url=https://angle80.itch.io/never-shall-we-part]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个孤独的女巫和一个鲁莽的女孩相爱，但鲁莽是有代价的，孤独的女孩不会轻易放手。

[来自[url=https://angle80.itch.io/never-shall-we-part]Itch.io[/url]]
